base_url.correction: Self-hosted; there is no universal base URL. A Recorder publishing endpoint is http[s]://recorder_host[:port]/pub.

example.correction: Use POST /pub with explicit user and device identification, for example: curl -u YOUR_USERNAME:YOUR_PASSWORD -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"_type":"location","lat":51.0,"lon":-0.1,"tst":1710000000,"tid":"me"}' 'https://your-recorder.example.com/pub?u=YOUR_USERNAME&d=YOUR_DEVICE'. A successful Recorder response is typically HTTP 200 with [].

notes: The project remains active, but this entry has no callable universal API host. Its JSON documentation moved from /booklet/api/json/ to /booklet/tech/json/. The sample also omits the Recorder's documented device identification and inaccurately describes the normal response as an empty body or broker acknowledgment.
